requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement describes a user interaction followed by a system reaction. The referential ambiguity regarding 'it' is resolved by the controlled context (BR-01/BR-02), identifying the invalid access card as the trigger for immediate denial. The requirement is structured as a single functional requirement.

source_fragments: The customer inserts the access card into the card reader and enters a personal identification number (PIN) at the keypad. If it is invalid, the system shall deny the access.

fields.condition: The customer inserts the access card into the card reader and enters a personal identification number (PIN) at the keypad

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the access card is invalid, the system shall deny the access.
structuring_notes: Resolved referential ambiguity 'it' -> 'access card' based on BR-01 and BR-02. Combined the pre-condition (insertion/PIN entry) with the trigger condition (invalid card) into a single functional requirement.
